prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling school science fair in a gymnasium. On the left, a boy in a blue cap stands beside a volcano model erupting with foam. Next to him, a girl in yellow overalls points at the bubbling lava while holding a clipboard. A teacher in a grey suit looks at their project with interest. In the center, a robot with silver arms sits on a wooden table. A cat with orange fur sleeps peacefully next to the robot. A man in a red scarf leans over to pet the cat gently. Behind them, a poster board displays colorful charts. To the right, a teenager in a green hoodie holds a magnifying glass up to a leaf specimen. Beside the teen, a woman in a pink dress smiles while handing a ribbon to a small child in striped socks. The child reaches out eagerly to take the award. Nearby, a golden retriever sits calmly on the floor, watching the exchange. A backpack lies open next to the dog, spilling out notebooks. In the background, a principal in a black tie observes the crowd from afar. A stack of pizza boxes rests on a folding table near the entrance. A janitor in blue coverages sweeps debris near the pizza. A balloon floats above the janitor’s head, tethered to a chair leg. A laptop sits open on a desk in the far corner, displaying data. There is no sunlight streaming through windows. There is no chalkboard visible on the walls. There is no fire extinguisher mounted nearby.
